These kinases are targets of multiple compounds, including Javanicoside F, Corticatic Acid E, and Calcium;4-Oxopentanoate;Dihydrate, all of which share a common pathway of targeting the same kinase. This indicates a possible functional overlap or shared mechanism of action among the compounds, which may contribute to their ability to influence the same biological process. The integration of these targets highlights a potential role for Npc115753 in modulating the activity of these kinases, which in turn may affect SF-188 through downstream signaling pathways. The evidence supports a mechanism where Npc115753 could act as a modulator of the kinase activity, potentially influencing SF-188's function through a shared target.
